title: Muge, Magtubo stamp class anew in Rexona 10 Miler Makati leg
summary: Gilbert Muge and Edna Magtubo once again ruled their respective fields as the Rexona 10 Miler Series 2026 made its way to Makati on Sunday at the Ayala Triangle Gardens.
